# Hooks reference

Generated from Pedal CMS 0.7.0. This page lists every action and filter the plugin fires, found by scanning the source, so it always matches the code. Each entry shows the arguments in the order they are passed, the plugin version that introduced the hook when the docblock says so, and links to the exact lines that fire it. If you are new to hooks, start with [Working with hooks](hooks.md), then come back here when you need the details.

Pedal CMS fires 14 actions and 32 filters. Names in braces, such as `{$option}`, are built at runtime. The part in braces is a placeholder for a value you choose when you add your callback.

### `pedalcms/subpage_document_title_part`

Filters the 'title' part of document_title_part for subpages.

**Arguments:** `$subpage->document_title . ', ' . $title['title']`, `$subpage->document_title`, `$title['title']`, `$subpage`, `$title`

**Since:** 0.1

**Parameters:**

- `$title_part` (`string`) - The resulting 'title' part.
- `$subpage_doc_title` (`string`) - The document_title property of the subpage.

- `$subpage` (`Subpage`) - The current/active Subpage object.
- `$title_parts` (`array`) - The complete title parts from `document_title_parts` filter.

### `pedalcms/toggletip_button_text`

Filters the text that appears on the ToggleTip button.

Note that the expected button text is a single character. Any HTML can be used, including SVG or an img tag, but anything other than a single character will likely impact the styling of the button. You should escape any HTML before returning it.

**Arguments:** `'?'`

**Parameters:**

- `$button_text` (`string`) - The button text.

**Source:** [src/template-tags-shared.php:381](https://github.com/PedalCMS/pedalcms/blob/v0.7.0/src/template-tags-shared.php#L381)
